sources.name: Ben Davidson — Space Weather News
sources.focus: Daily solar watch, CME impact calls, Disaster Cycle, micronova

items.headline: Earth Vulnerability, Micronova Events, Ozone | S0 News Nov.26.2026
items.summary: Ben Davidson discusses a study comparing a recent geomagnetic storm with the May 2024 storm and argues it shows Earth's growing vulnerability. He also ties a new stellar-nebula study to his micronova theory.

items.headline: Solar Ozone Depletion Event, Mercury Arrival | S0 News Nov.25.2026
items.summary: Ben Davidson reviews a paper on solar storms depleting ozone and covers BepiColombo's arrival at Mercury. He also highlights radio signals from flaring stars and a new Webb result.

items.headline: The First Gamma Ray Ground Event Recorded | S0 News Nov.22.2026
items.summary: Ben Davidson reports what he describes as the first recorded ground-level gamma-ray event and discusses its significance. This is his interpretation; it is not an NOAA/NASA space-weather alert.

items.headline: Pole Shift History & Today's Collapse | S0 News Nov.21.2026
items.summary: Ben Davidson reviews past geomagnetic pole shifts and argues the present-day magnetic field is weakening along a similar path. He frames this as part of his Disaster Cycle thesis.

items.headline: Says ECDO theory is being overlooked
items.summary: Posted that he finds it hard to understand why ECDO theory has not yet been examined, calling the case for it obvious. The post's full context was not visible in search results.

items.headline: Co-launches the Catastrophism Research Association
items.summary: Named among the founders of a new research body studying cyclical geophysical cataclysm.

items.headline: Havenbound opens to the public
items.summary: Announced public launch after about a year of development; the service produces a safety report for any coordinate on Earth.

items.headline: Comments on Craig Stone's ECDO simulation
items.summary: Says she is watching where Craig Stone's full simulation leads, highlighting its relaxation phase after the forcing period.

items.headline: ECDO vs EDC: argues ECDO is more likely
items.summary: X article arguing the crust tends to stay with the mantle, which he says favors the ECDO model over the alternative.

items.headline: Shares Ben Davidson on deep-ocean heating
items.summary: Posted an excerpt in which Davidson claims new evidence that deep oceans are warming sharply.

items.headline: Overview of the 2026 Pole Shift Conference presentations
items.summary: Wrote a summary of Roger Cunningham's and Ben Davidson's conference talks, which David Sunfellow recommended to his followers.

items.headline: Inversion — ECDO Theory
items.summary: Most recent article found by search. Announces a forthcoming work, "A New Knowledge," which he says explains the mechanism behind cataclysm, tradition and climate; check his X feed for newer posts.

predictions.prediction: An ~X10-class solar flare will occur next year, after which 'the world is never the same'
